originalStatementAttestation.copyMethod: Byte-exact complete div.problem-statement element, including all paragraphs, constraints, sample and note; no HTML cleanup. Full page chrome omitted.
originalStatementAttestation.images: Only explanatory fractions in the note are image-backed in original HTML; the pinned note retains their TeX and explicit six route totals. The actual question, constraints and required output are fully text-backed and unambiguous.

semantics.constraints: Exactly two lines: one integer n in 2..100000, then n distinct integers in 1..10000000. The input format is authoritative over the informal description's non-negative wording, so zero is illegal.
semantics.checker: stdio; no interaction or generated checker; unique positive reduced numerator and positive denominator as two integer tokens; no floating-point or custom comparison.
semantics.oracleDerivation: In a uniformly selected permutation, each destination is first with probability 1/n. Each unordered pair is consecutive with probability 2/n: glue the pair in either order, yielding 2*(n-1)! out of n! routes. Expected route length is (sum(ai)+2*sum(i<j,abs(ai-aj)))/n. No return-to-origin leg is present. Sorting and prefix accumulation compute all pair distances exactly; gcd reduction gives the unique output.
semantics.complexity: O(n log n) time, O(n) space, integer-only arithmetic.
semantics.independentBrute: Literal enumeration of every route, walking from 0 through the complete permutation and averaging full route lengths with Fraction. Exhaustive ordered distinct arrays from 1..5 at n=2..5; each combination from 1..9 at n=2..6 in both directions; 200 seeded random distinct arrays at n=2..7. No calls to the efficient oracle from the reference.

authoredSuite.maximumCases: Four legal n=100000 cases: low consecutive, descending high consecutive, two distant clusters and seeded unsorted wide unique coordinates.
authoredSuite.otherCoverage: Minimum n and coordinate endpoints; no, partial and full gcd cancellation; unsorted and alternating gaps; translated/shuffled arithmetic progressions; multi-digit n; separated medium clusters; seeded small routes with uneven gaps.

sourceMotivation.observation: Selected WA sources apply sorted rank/gap formulas to unsorted input without sorting; descending/shuffled/alternating inputs exercise that issue.
Selected WA sources read n as int(line[0]); legal multi-digit n cases exercise truncated coordinate processing.
Selected WA source uses 8*(last-first)+2*sum and n! denominator, rather than general all-pair expected distance; irregular n=4 and larger cases exercise this.
